# {xpay} Documentation

> AI Agent Payment Control Platform - non-custodial spending controls and API monetization via the x402 protocol

Website: https://docs.xpay.sh
Platform: https://xpay.sh
Hub: https://hub.xpay.sh

## Products

### Smart Proxy
Cost control proxy for autonomous AI agents. Set per-request, daily, and monthly spending limits. Sits between your agent and x402-powered APIs.
- Docs: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/products/smart-proxy

### Paywall-as-a-Service
Wrap any API with x402 payment requirements. Instant monetization with flexible pricing (per-request, tiered, token-based).
- Docs: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/products/paywall-service

### MCP Monetization
Monetize any MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with pay-per-tool-call billing. Zero code changes required.
- Docs: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/products/mcp-monetization

### xpay Hub
Marketplace for AI agents, tools, and prompts (RDAs). Run AI services with pay-per-use pricing.
- Docs: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/hub
- Live: https://hub.xpay.sh

## x402 Protocol

Open payment protocol using HTTP 402 status code for instant stablecoin micropayments.
- Overview: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/x402-protocol
- xpay Facilitator: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/x402-protocol/facilitator

### xpay Facilitator
Free x402 facilitator service for USDC payment verification and settlement on Base.
- URL: https://facilitator.xpay.sh
- Networks: Base mainnet (eip155:8453), Base Sepolia (eip155:84532)
- Protocol versions: v1, v2
- Endpoints: /health, /supported, /verify, /settle

## Hub API Reference

Base URL: https://api.xpay.sh/hub

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | /run | Execute an RDA |
| GET | /rdas | List all RDAs |
| GET | /rda/{slug} | Get RDA details |
| POST | /rda | Create an RDA |
| GET | /wallet/balance | Check wallet balance |
| POST | /wallet/deposit | Record deposit |

- Universal Webhook: https://docs.xpay.sh/en/integrations/universal-webhook

## Key Technical Details

- Blockchain: Base (Coinbase L2), USDC stablecoin
- Architecture: Non-custodial (funds never held by xpay)
- Settlement: ~2 seconds on Base
- SDK: @xpaysh/agent-kit (TypeScript)
- Auth: Privy (Hub), API keys (integrations)
